data: Same 26,278 target-disease pairs and deterministic Ensembl-target 70/15/15 split as Experiment 011.
local_statistical_front_end: Per-channel weighted logistic calibrator using evidence presence plus score, score^2 and score^3; its calibrated log-odds is appended to the native channel input.
shared_ganglion: Six channel-specific encoders -> availability-normalized aggregation -> 16x16 tanh ganglion -> Bernoulli human-outcome head.
pipeline_dropout: Training samples one availability mask with 3-6 available channels. Pipeline unavailability is encoded separately from biological evidence absence.
masked_polynomial: Classical logistic model with observed scores, presence flags, availability flags, pairwise score/presence interactions, and availability/evidence counts.
precision_hybrid: Validation-selected logit blend between Stat-PsyMoE and masked polynomial, alpha in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}.
evaluation: Target-holdout log loss with 0,1,2,3 unavailable evidence pipelines; all missingness combinations are enumerated at evaluation.
